subject: Geo-tethered list-price adjustment & channel offsets for private offer
messages:
From: Sam O'Neill <s.oneill@avatech.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-17T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request — EU list price tether + reseller commission

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Quick follow up from procurement here: Ava is preparing a private offer for reserved capacity across EMEA and we need to ensure the list price is tethered to local EU list pricing (we have VAT and regional levies to account for).

High-level ask: can Redwood provide a private offer that: 1) applies a 25% list discount off published list for a 12–24 month reserved commitment, 2) allows us to present a geo-adjusted list price in the EU market (we need a 6–9% uplift to protect gross margins), and 3) sets reseller commission to EdgeCloud Partners at 8% of net invoice?

We also need clarity on invoice routing and passback: EdgeCloud wants reseller credits on their invoice line and Ava needs to consume the capacity under our org. Will Redwood route invoices to Ava and issue reseller credit to EdgeCloud, or should EdgeCloud invoice Ava directly?

Can you share a draft private offer and a quick breakdown of economics (list price, discounted net, reseller commission and net to Redwood)? Also include any procurement steps for DocuSign and required PO fields.

Thanks — Sam
Sam O'Neill
Head of Cloud Procurement, Ava Technologies

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam O'Neill <s.oneill@avatech.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer request — Ava (geo-tether + reseller ask)

Ben / Irene — looping you in to advise on passback mechanics and margin impact. Summary of ask from Ava: geo-tethered EU list price (they want a 6–9% uplift to list to cover VAT and local levies), a 25% discount off list for reserved capacity, and EdgeCloud Partners to receive an 8% reseller commission. They want our invoice to go to Ava but EdgeCloud to receive reseller credit.

Initial thoughts: we can support a geo-tethered list price by publishing an EU-specific list SKU and mapping the private offer to that SKU. For commissions, our standard reseller rate is 7% for marketplace private offers; we can stretch to 8% if Ava signs a 24-month committed term or agrees to a modest onboarding checkbox (one-time professional services purchase).

I attached a draft private offer (avatech_privoffer_v1.pdf) and a short pricing workup (pricing_workup_avatech.xlsx). Ben — can you run margin impact and confirm whether we can flex to 8% under a 24‑month commitment or if we should prefer an onboarding credit? Irene — need to confirm invoice routing options and whether we can emit an invoice to Ava while sending reseller credit to EdgeCloud.

Goal: respond to Ava with a clean proposal and DocuSign link by next week.

Thanks,
Priyom
Sr. Sales Manager — Cloud Marketplace, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-18T09:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request — Ava (geo-tether + reseller ask)

On Thu, May 17, 2028 at 3:04 PM priyom_das@redwood.ai wrote:
> Initial thoughts: we can support a geo-tethered list price by publishing an EU-specific list SKU and mapping the private offer to that SKU. For commissions, our standard reseller rate is 7% for marketplace private offers; we can stretch to 8% if Ava signs a 24‑month committed term or agrees to a modest onboarding checkbox (one-time professional services purchase).

Agree with the approach. A few specifics from channel side:
- If we publish an EU list SKU, the backend passback to EdgeCloud can be done two ways: 1) Redwood invoices Ava and issues a separate reseller credit note to EdgeCloud (adds ops work), or 2) EdgeCloud invoices Ava as the reseller and we net settle EdgeCloud against Redwood (preferred from an accounting simplicity standpoint).
- Margin workup (example numbers):
  * Published EU list = €100k/month
  * 25% discount => €75k/month net to Ava
  * Reseller commission @7% of net => €5.25k/month to EdgeCloud
  * If we grant 8% (conditional on 24m), commission => €6k/month; Redwood net goes down by €0.75k/month — annualized ~€9k.
- Recommendation: hold commission at 7% and offer a one-time onboarding credit of €9k (or equivalent professional services) if they go 24 months. This preserves recurring margin but achieves the same economic incentive for EdgeCloud.
- If procurement insists, we can bend to 8% but require a written credit-recap clause in the SOW that limits future passbacks (protects Redwood).

Irene — can you confirm operational feasibility for option 1 (Redwood invoiced, Redwood credit note to EdgeCloud) and estimate the time to implement the credit note flow? If it'll add >2 weeks operational lift, we push for EdgeCloud-invoices-Ava route.

Ben
Director, Channel Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Sam O'Neill <s.oneill@avatech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-05-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Private offer request — Geo-tethered list price & EdgeCloud commission — Updated proposal

Hi Sam — thanks for the fast turn. Following internal alignment, attached is an updated private offer and a short economics summary (see attachments). Key points:

- Offer: 25% off EU published list for a 24‑month reserved commitment across compute SKU family.
- Geo-tethering: EU list SKU will be published and the private offer will reference that SKU so invoicing to EU entities reflects local list pricing. We are accounting for a 7% list uplift in the EU list SKU to cover VAT/levies in our pricebook (not an additional fee to Ava).
- Reseller commission: standard 7% of net invoice payable to EdgeCloud Partners. As a trade-off, Redwood will provide a one-time onboarding credit of €9,000 to EdgeCloud if Ava signs the 24‑month commitment.
- Invoice routing: preferred path is EdgeCloud invoices Ava directly (EdgeCloud as reseller) and Redwood settles via a monthly netting report. If Ava requires Redwood to invoice Ava directly, Redwood can issue a reseller credit note to EdgeCloud but that will require an ops lead time (estimate 10 business days after signing).

Action items for you: please confirm which invoice path you prefer (EdgeCloud-invoices-Ava vs Redwood-invoices-Ava + Redwood-credit-to-EdgeCloud) and confirm acceptance of the 24‑month/€9k onboarding credit trade. If acceptable, we will send the DocuSign envelope (link below) with the private offer and SOW fields prefilled. Please reply by 2028-05-25 to hold pricing.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/AVA-PO-0289
Attachments: avatech_privoffer_v1.pdf, pricing_workup_avatech.xlsx

Best,
Priyom
Sr. Sales Manager — Cloud Marketplace
Redwood Inference
